name: Phoenix TSMC Fab 3 Topping-Out Milestone
known_limitations: The City page establishes a topping-out ceremony and relays that initial construction had begun on a fourth fab and first advanced-packaging plant. Topping out is not equipment installation, certificate of occupancy, qualification, production, audited capacity, utility service, or measured economic impact.
automation_notes: Follow named building permits, inspections, certificates of occupancy, equipment installation, utility and wastewater service, workforce, qualification, and production milestones for each facility.
notes: Phase 55N physical-construction record. The final and highest beam is a distinct building milestone but remains upstream of operating semiconductor capacity.
